description: This file contains Go test code implementing end-to-end tests for Android Cuttlefish CVD snapshot functionalities, including creating devices, taking snapshots, restoring from snapshots, and verifying device state.

methods.name: TestSnapshot
methods.description: Main test function that creates a device, takes a snapshot, verifies snapshot restoration, and checks device state.

methods.name: uploadArtifacts
methods.description: Uploads necessary artifacts to the server, returning the upload directory path.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a CVD device with specified group and artifacts directory.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the device via the server, returning the snapshot response.

methods.name: getCVD
methods.description: Retrieves the first available CVD device from the server.
